n: Tushen Cloud Computing (Kwamfutar Gajimare)

n: Tushen Taimakon IT (Shirin Jarabawar CompTIA A+)

n: Tushen Tsaro a Wurin Aiki (OSHA)
s: Gano haɗari, Zaɓa da amfani da PPE, Hana zamewa, tuntuɓe da faɗuwa, Ɗaga kaya lafiya, Karanta takardar bayanin tsaron sinadari, Kai rahoton rauni da amfani da…

n: Tushen Walda (Welding)
s: Daidaita ayyuka da hanyoyin walda, Karanta haɗi, matsayi da alamun walda, Gane lahanin walda da aka saba gani, Shirya tsaron walda da kariya daga gobara,…

n: Tsaron Intanet na Matakin Farko (Shirin Jarabawar CompTIA Security+)

n: Yin Magana a Gaban Jama'a da Gabatarwa

n: Zaɓin Kwaleji, Sana'a ko Aiki Bayan Makaranta

s: Sanin matsayin kowa a faɗakarwar manoma, Tsara zaman horo na nuna-gwada-tattauna, Gudanar da gonar nuni da zaman makarantar gona, Ba da shawara da gaskiya da…

n: Zane-zanen Hoto (Graphic Design) da Canva
s: Rubuta tsarin zane (design brief), Amfani da ƙa'idojin tsara shafi, Zaɓar launuka da rubutu (font), Gina zane a Canva, Duba haƙƙin hoto da sauƙin karantawa,…
d: Wannan kwas ɗin na matasa ne da ke neman aikin fasaha na farko, manya da ke son ƙara ƙwarewa a takardar bayanin aikinsu (CV), masu ƙananan kasuwanci da 'yan kasuwa da ke yin tallansu da kansu, da ma'aikata da masu sa kai na ƙungiyoyin agaji da ke yin flyer don taruka da masu…
